preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string s must be uppercase letters.
The input string s must contain at least three different characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the longest string formed by characters in descending ASCII order from the input string.

postconditions.expression: any(ord(c) - ord(next_c) == 1 for c, next_c in zip(stdout, stdout[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output string must have characters in arithmetic progression with a common difference of at least 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == max((s[i] for i in range(len(s))), key=lambda x: ord(x))
postconditions.description: The output string must consist of characters with the highest ASCII values from the input string.
